description: This file contains a report implementation for item prices in an ERP system, including functions to fetch item details, price lists, purchase rates, BOM rates, and valuation rates, and to generate report columns and data.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate item prices report based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Returns report column headers based on filters.

methods.name: get_item_details
methods.description: Fetches item details from the database based on conditions.

methods.name: get_price_list
methods.description: Retrieves selling and buying price list information for items.

methods.name: get_last_purchase_rate
methods.description: Gets the most recent purchase rate for each item.

methods.name: get_item_bom_rate
methods.description: Calculates BOM rate for items from BOM data.

methods.name: get_valuation_rate
methods.description: Calculates average valuation rate of items across warehouses.

methods.name: get_condition
methods.description: Builds SQL condition string based on filters for item status.
